abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

user.description: Do you want to set up Device link tools? It adds actions to link entities to a device, and creates no entities of its own.

entity_not_registered.message: {entity_id} has no entity registry entry, so it cannot be linked to a device. An entity only gets one when its integration gives it a unique ID; add a unique_id to its configuration and reload it.

identifiers_ambiguous.message: Several devices match the identifiers {identifiers}: {devices}. Use identifiers that only one of them carries.

link_refused.message: The entity registry refused to link {entity_id} to the device {device_id}, because that device id belongs to a device that was split between config entries. Use the identifiers of one of the resulting devices instead.

source_not_linked.message: {entity_id} is not linked to any device, so there is nothing to clone.

domain.description: Integration that owns the device, for example 'mqtt'.
domain.name: Domain

identifier.description: Identifier of the device within that integration, for example '8848_5'.
identifier.name: Identifier

add_identifier.description: Links entities to the device that carries the given identifiers.

entity_id.description: Entities to link to the device.
entity_id.name: Entities

identifiers.description: Identifiers of the target device. Read them with the 'Read identifiers' action on an entity that is already linked to it.
identifiers.name: Identifiers

add_identifier.name: Add identifier

clone.description: Copies the device link of one entity onto other entities, without having to type the identifiers again.

source_entity_id.description: Entity whose device link is copied.
source_entity_id.name: Source entity

target_entity_id.description: Entities that are linked to the same device as the source entity.
target_entity_id.name: Target entities

clone.name: Clone device link

read_identifiers.description: Reads the identifiers of the device an entity is currently linked to.

entity_id.description: Entity to read the device link of.
entity_id.name: Entity

read_identifiers.name: Read identifiers

remove_identifier.description: Unlinks entities from the device they are linked to.

entity_id.description: Entities to unlink from their device.
entity_id.name: Entities

remove_identifier.name: Remove identifier
